name: round
title: Round
description: "Round 2 of 5": a number and a ceiling, and almost nothing else. A thin wrapper over stat, which already knows that a value with a max reads as a fraction on screen and as "2 of 5" to a screen reader. It performs nothing and decides nothing; it exists so a host writes the round rather than remembering which stat kind a round is, and so a test can find the round on a surface that also carries a score and a timer. Draws as a row of segment pips — done, the one the player is on, and coming — beside the words, which is what the design draws. Without a max there is no sequence to draw and the pips give way to the bare number, because an endless mode is a real case.
docs: Pass `value` for the round the player is on, 1-based like every other position in the contract, and `max` for how many there are when that is known in advance. Leave `max` off for an endless ladder; the round is still a number. Pass `label` to call it something else, a question or a leg or a heat, and the accessible name follows. `data-gs-value` and `data-gs-max` carry the two numbers separately, so nothing has to parse "2/5".
